exposure: Nasal intermittent positive pressure ventilation (NIPPV) combined with very early surfactant treatment
outcome: need for mechanical ventilation (MV) in the first 72 hours of life
cohort: Premature infants with a gestational age of 24-31 6/7 weeks who required supplemental oxygen with evidence of labored breathing within 60 minutes of birth.
finding: The failure rate of NIPPV, defined as the need for mechanical ventilation within 72 hours, was significantly lower when combined with very early surfactant treatment compared to NIPPV alone.
